shots.caption: Every session on every host, with the ones that need you at the top.
shots.alt: Pohunek Companion session list in the dark theme with the My groups view selected: a Needs you section with two blocked agent sessions, the Inbox group collapsed to its header, and the Dependencies group listing sessions of a second host. The bottom bar has a search icon and the State, Project and Host filter chips.

shots.caption: Tap the search icon and the field takes the whole bar; the list narrows to the sessions that match, on every host.
shots.alt: Pohunek Companion session list in the dark theme with the bottom bar expanded into a full-width search field holding the query tokio, over the two sessions of two hosts that match it.

shots.caption: Narrow the list from the bottom bar by state, project or host; here one project is shown with its ended sessions.
shots.alt: Pohunek Companion session list in the dark theme with the bottom filter bar showing a search icon, a State chip with a count of four, a project chip and a Host chip, over the sessions of that one project including an ended one.

shots.caption: The project picker is searchable and lists the projects you picked last first.
shots.alt: Pohunek Companion project picker sheet in the dark theme: a search field, a Recent section with the three projects picked last, then the full list of projects.

shots.caption: A full-screen terminal attached to a running session; this one runs a scripted demo of an agent at work.
shots.alt: Pohunek Companion full-screen terminal in the dark theme showing the output of a scripted demo program: a build log, a test run with a progress bar and a pass summary, and a prompt line.

shots.caption: Tap the terminal for the keyboard; an accessory bar above it holds the keys a phone keyboard lacks.
shots.alt: Pohunek Companion terminal in the dark theme with the on-screen keyboard up and, above it, a row of accessory keys: Esc, Tab, Ctrl, Alt and the arrow keys.

shots.caption: Start a session on a host from a project template, with its agent and prompt filled in.
shots.alt: Pohunek Companion New session form in the dark theme with a project template selected, its agent chosen and its prompt filled in.

shots.caption: The same sessions grouped by what they are doing, so the ones waiting for you come first.
shots.alt: Pohunek Companion session list in the dark theme with the By state view selected: sessions in Needs you, Working and Idle sections.

shots.caption: Your own groups, shared with the desktop app, hold the sessions you sort into them.
shots.alt: Pohunek Companion My groups view in the dark theme: Needs you at the top, then the Dependencies group open with its sessions and a count, below the two blocked ones.

shots.caption: The hosts the app follows, each with its connection state.
shots.alt: Pohunek Companion Hosts screen in the dark theme: two hosts, each with its address and a Connected status, and an Add a host button.

shots.caption: Every session row has an action sheet to open, rename, move, stop or remove it.
shots.alt: Pohunek Companion action sheet for one session in the dark theme, listing Open terminal, Details, Rename, New session here, Move to group, Open link, Stop and Remove.

shots.caption: The identity, agent and location of one session, each field with a Copy button.
shots.alt: Pohunek Companion session details screen in the dark theme: identity, agent and location fields of one session, each with a Copy button.
